title: GHOSTCLAW Worker Capabilities Schema
description: Schema for defining worker capabilities in the GHOSTCLAW sub-agent worker registry

role.description: Functional role of the worker (e.g., orchestrator, builder, mapper)

model_lane.description: Model lane the worker operates in (e.g., hermes, codex, kimi, glm, deepseek, opus, any)

capabilities.description: List of capability strings this worker possesses

allowed_actions.description: Actions this worker is permitted to execute

blocked_actions.description: Actions this worker is explicitly prohibited from executing

input_schema.description: JSON schema for the worker's input messages

output_schema.description: JSON schema for the worker's output messages

heartbeat_required.description: Whether the worker must emit periodic heartbeats

receipt_required.description: Whether every worker action requires a receipt

self_approval_allowed.description: Whether self-approval is permitted. Must always be false per GHOSTCLAW autonomous mutual approval policy.
